0.original: Bujir knew you would be coming.

24.original: Investigate the Uyagir Caves and slay any enemies that appear.

48.original: Welcome, adventurer. Ibakha told me you would be coming.

49.original: She sees events long before they come to pass.

50.original: However, she did not only see you. No, she also foresaw a great threat.

51.original: The true nature of this threat is yet unclear, but we know it lurks in the Uyagir Caves. Please investigate it on our behalf.

52.original: The true nature of this threat is yet unclear, but we know it lurks in the Uyagir Caves. Please investigate it on our behalf.

54.original: Pray tell me, just what did you find?

55.original: A bird of prophecy? I must thank you for slaying it. That cave contains the minerals we use to create pigment.

56.original: Without those minerals, we could not paint images on the walls of our cave─images which show the danger of giving in to one's greed. We do this every full moon so that future generations may inherit our values.

57.original: My sincerest thanks for all your help. We owe you a great debt.
